title: Exercise: Part Counter with Reset
oneLiner: Count parts passing a photo-eye in batches of ten, with a reset button, so that a part sitting in front of the sensor still counts once.
keyTakeaway: A CTU counts edges, resets on R (which wins over counting) and flags the batch with Q when CV reaches PV.
explanation: A photo-eye on a conveyor sees parts go past, and the line packs them in tens. Count the parts, flag a full batch, and let the operator reset the count. Parts can stop in front of the eye, so count each part's arrival, not the time it spends there.
